A fan started clapping Cardi B’s booty, but she checked them out right away 👀🍑

Cardi B, whose real name is Belcalis Marlenis Almánzar, is an American rapper, songwriter, and media personality who became one of the most prominent female hip-hop artists of her generation. Raised in New York City, she first gained widespread attention in the mid-2010s through viral social media posts on Vine and Instagram. She later built on that momentum by starring in the reality television series *Love & Hip Hop: New York*.

She launched into global superstardom in 2017 with her breakout single “Bodak Yellow,” which topped the Billboard Hot 100 chart. Her debut studio album, *Invasion of Privacy* (2018), was a massive critical and commercial success, earning her the Grammy Award for Best Rap Album and making her the first solo female artist to win the category. Known for her unfiltered personality, distinct aggressive delivery, and hit collaborations like “I Like It” and “WAP,” Cardi B has earned multiple record-breaking achievements, including having the most number-one singles on the Billboard Hot 100 for a female rapper.
